parts.text: Which set could count as evidence of what happened during the experiment?
Give one reason for your choice.

stem:
Noor fries puris in hot oil and wants evidence to make sense of the changes she sees.

She considers four possible records:
1  the time each puri takes to puff up
2  the brand name printed on the oil bottle
3  whether each puri puffed up or stayed flat
4  how many times the oil spluttered during frying

part_answers.answer: Times, puff outcomes, and splutter counts are observations from the frying; the brand name on the bottle is not evidence of what happened in the experiment.

teacher.key_rationale: Evidence is what was observed or measured during the frying: puff times, puff outcomes, and splutter counts. The printed brand name is not experimental evidence of those changes.
